name: Scabbard of Wrath
body:
Aura faint transmutation; CL 6th; Slot —; Price 36,000 gp; Weight 1 lb.

DESCRIPTION

A scabbard of wrath is typically made from the preserved hide of a hated enemy of the tribe of the lizardfolk who made the item. It can shrink, expand, or change shape to fit any one-handed sword or similar bladed weapon. The scabbard of wrath can be activated once per day as a free action when drawing a weapon from it. For 1 minute after drawing it, when the wielder uses one of the Vital Strike feats to attack with that weapon, she may also multiply the weapon’s enhancement bonus to damage (if any) by the number of damage dice she rolls when using those feats.

Additionally, critical hits scored with the affected weapon during this effect’s duration ignore the first 10 points of a target’s damage reduction (except for DR/epic).

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Wondrous Item; Spells rage, versatile weapon; Cost 18,000 gp
